answer: Submission-timing correlation catches farms that share one scheduler. First, the ledger stamps every answer to the millisecond from the dawn of each epoch. Second, it compares arrival gaps across accounts over 30 epochs. Third, any group whose gaps line up within 50 ms more than 70% of the time loses half its rewards. Beating it means giving each of 1,000 fakes its own host and random jitter, roughly $5 a month per VPS, so $5,000 monthly, plus distinct writing for each. Spotting them is like watching a jetty at low tide: the posts that rise together were sunk by one crew.
